# AI Engineering OS v0.1.0

## Highlights

- Compiles a tool-agnostic `.ai/` workspace into runtime-specific artifacts.
- Supports Claude Code and Codex adapters.
- Provides deterministic compilation and generated-output verification.
- Includes `ai sync`, `ai validate`, `ai --help`, and `ai --version`.
- Exposes a small Node.js API for compilation, validation, manifests, and
  adapter registries.

## Philosophy

Repositories own AI intent. The compiler owns runtime implementation. The
`.ai/` workspace is the source of truth, while generated runtime directories
are reproducible build artifacts.

## Supported runtimes

- Claude Code
- Codex

## Public API

The package exports:

```js
compile(options)
validate(options)
loadManifest(root)
createAdapterRegistry(directory)
validateAdapterRegistry(registry)
```

## Looking ahead to v0.2

Planned areas include dependency and context graphs, incremental compilation,
path-aware rules, workspace support, adapter plugins, and watch mode.
